search_axes: Latest text-guided medical segmentation and QaTa-COV19
Template repetition and false negatives in image-text contrastive learning
Spatial-aware alignment, directional priors, optimal transport
Incomplete textual prompts and attribute-specific cross-modal segmentation
Phrase-instance alignment, rejection/null target and generalized referring segmentation
Counterfactual semantic and spatial text perturbations, including remote sensing
Differential attention, negative reference text and inference calibration
Probability mass redistribution, mass conservation and volume-preserving segmentation
excluded_standalone_novelty_claims: Add cross attention or bidirectional interaction
Split report clauses or learn phrase queries
Repair incomplete prompts / add a null or rejection query
Introduce a volume/mass preserving segmentation layer
remaining_hypothesis: A same-image relation-specific textual evidence difference used at inference under baseline soft-mass projection may help localization without a new region-label auxiliary objective. Its incremental value over text matching, counterfactual training, and image-only constrained correction is untested.
limitations: This is a bounded literature search, not proof of absence or a patent/FTO opinion.
Paper metrics, datasets, text encoders, training budgets and aggregation were not harmonized.
The candidate components have strong prior art; only a demonstrated useful joint mechanism could support a limited method contribution.
Full-text access remained incomplete for one particularly relevant sub-text alignment paper.
